en.name: Dark Circles Treatment
en.meta_title: Under-Eye Dark Circles Treatment: Fillers & Advanced Therapies
en.meta_description: Look more rested and refreshed with our dark circles treatment. We use tear trough fillers and other advanced therapies to correct under-eye hollows and pigmentation, restoring brightness and vitality to your appearance.
en.meta_keywords: dark circles treatment, tear trough filler, under-eye filler, tired eyes, eye rejuvenation, cosmetic treatment, hyaluronic acid filler

what_is.heading: What Causes Dark Circles? A Multi-Faceted Approach
paragraphs: Dark under-eye circles can make you look tired, stressed, or older than you are. At LUNAI, we offer a multi-faceted approach to dark circle treatment, because we understand that the cause is often complex, stemming from volume loss, hyperpigmentation, thin skin, or a combination of factors.

tear_trough.heading: Tear Trough Fillers for Volume Loss
paragraphs: Our most effective treatment for dark circles caused by volume loss is the use of tear trough fillers. By carefully injecting a smooth hyaluronic acid filler into the hollow area under the eyes, we can plump the skin, reduce the shadow effect, and create a seamless transition between the cheek and lower eyelid. This immediately brightens the area and gives a more rested appearance.

other_treatments.heading: Treatments for Pigmentation and Thin Skin
paragraphs: For dark circles caused by pigmentation, we may recommend a course of gentle chemical peels or advanced skin therapies. Microneedling can also be effective in thickening the skin and boosting collagen to make underlying blood vessels less visible. During your consultation, we will perform a thorough assessment to create a personalized treatment plan that restores brightness to your under-eye area.
